words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.ex: He took a pill for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒药丸来缓解头痛。
words.en: A pill is a small solid mass of medicine that you swallow whole.

words.ex: He got pneumonia after a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他得了重感冒后患了肺炎。
words.en: Pneumonia is a serious disease which affects your lungs and makes it difficult for you to breathe.

words.tr:
n. 毒药；毒物；
v. 毒害；
words.ex: The snake's poison can kill quickly.
words.ex_cn: 蛇的毒药能迅速致死。
words.en: A poison is a substance that causes harm or death if it is swallowed, absorbed, or breathed in. It can also refer to something that has a very harmful effect on something else.

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.tr: n. 实践者；从业者；执业者；
words.ex: He is a medical practitioner who helps patients every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位每天帮助病人的医疗实践者。
words.en: A practitioner is someone who works in a particular profession, especially one that requires special training and skills.

words.ex: Wear a helmet as a precaution when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔作为一种预防措施。
words.en: A precaution is an action that is intended to prevent something dangerous or unpleasant from happening.

words.ex: The doctor wrote a prescription for medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了一张药方。
words.en: A prescription is a written order from a physician for the preparation and administration of a drug or device for a patient.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.tr: adj. 精神病的；精神病学的；
words.ex: He works in a psychiatric hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家精神病医院工作。
words.en: Psychiatric means relating to psychiatry or to mental illness.

words.tr: n. 精神病学家；精神科医生
words.ex: He visits a psychiatrist every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周去看一次精神科医生。
words.en: A psychiatrist is a medical doctor who specializes in the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of mental illnesses and emotional disorders.

words.ex: The doctor checked his pulse with his fingers.
words.ex_cn: 医生用手指检查了他的脉搏。
words.en: A pulse is the regular beating of the heart, especially when it is felt at the wrist or neck. It can also refer to a single vibration or short burst of sound, electric current, light, etc.

words.ex: The doctor checked his red blood cell count.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的红细胞计数。
words.en: A red blood cell is one of the cells in your blood that carries oxygen from your lungs to all parts of your body.

words.tr: phrase. 放松疗法；通过呼吸、冥想、渐进性肌肉放松等手段减轻压力与焦虑的心理或生理治疗方法
words.ex: He uses relaxation therapy to reduce stress.
words.ex_cn: 他使用放松疗法来减轻压力。
words.en: Relaxation therapy refers to a variety of techniques designed to teach a person to be able to relax voluntarily. It is often used to reduce stress, anxiety, and tension.

words.ex: The doctor suggested a natural remedy for the cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议了一种治疗感冒的天然疗法。
words.en: A remedy is a cure or a way of making something better.

words.ex: The resilient child bounced back quickly after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 这个适应力强的孩子在事故后很快恢复了。
words.en: Something that is resilient is strong and not easily damaged by being hit, stretched, or squeezed.

words.ex: He has a running nose because of the cold.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感冒而流鼻涕。
words.en: A condition where liquid drips from the nose.

words.ex: Dogs produce saliva when they smell food.
words.ex_cn: 狗闻到食物时会分泌唾液。
words.en: Saliva is the watery liquid that forms in your mouth and helps you to chew and digest food.

words.tr: adj. 感伤的；感情的；多愁善感的
words.ex: He kept the old toy because he was sentimental about it.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了那个旧玩具，因为他对它有感情。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as sentimental, you mean that they are influenced by emotional feelings, especially about happy memories of past events or relationships with other people, rather than by careful thought and judgment based on facts.

words.ex: He shivered in the cold wind.
words.ex_cn: 他在寒风中哆嗦。
words.en: If you shiver, your body shakes slightly because you are cold or frightened.

words.ex: He rubbed his shoulder after lifting the box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完箱子后揉了揉肩膀。
words.en: The part of the body at each side of the neck where the upper limb or forelimb is attached; to accept or take on (a responsibility or task).

words.ex: The sweater shrinks in hot water.
words.ex_cn: 这件毛衣在热水中会收缩。
words.en: If something shrinks or you shrink it, it becomes smaller.

words.ex: He has sleeplessness because of too much stress.
words.ex_cn: 他因为压力太大而失眠。
words.en: The condition of being unable to sleep.

words.ex: My throat is sore after singing.
words.ex_cn: 我唱歌后喉咙疼。
words.en: If part of your body is sore, it causes you pain and discomfort.

words.ex: He has a sore throat from singing too much.
words.ex_cn: 他因为唱太多歌而喉咙痛。
words.en: If you have a sore throat, your throat hurts and it is difficult for you to swallow.

words.ex: He is a specialist in heart surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他是心脏手术方面的专家。
words.en: A specialist is a person who is highly skilled or knowledgeable in a particular field.

words.ex: He lost his spleen in a car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在一场车祸中失去了脾脏。
words.en: The spleen is an organ involved in the production and removal of blood cells in most vertebrates and forming part of the immune system. It can also refer to feelings of anger or spite.

words.tr:
v. 扭伤
n. 扭伤
words.ex: He sprained his ankle while running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步时扭伤了脚踝。
words.en: If you sprain a joint such as your ankle or wrist, you accidentally damage it by twisting it or bending it violently.

words.ex: He has a stuffed nose from the cold.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感冒而鼻塞。
words.en: A stuffed nose refers to the condition where the nasal passages are blocked, often due to inflammation of the nasal tissues, making it difficult to breathe through the nose.

words.ex: He ate too much and his stomach hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，胃疼。
words.en: The stomach is the organ in your body where food is digested after you have eaten it.

words.ex: He had a stomachache after eating too much ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了太多冰淇淋后胃痛。
words.en: A stomachache is a pain in your stomach.

words.ex: The surgeon fixed the broken bone.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生修复了断裂的骨头。
words.en: A surgeon is a medical doctor who performs operations.

words.ex: He needs surgery for his broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 他需要做手术来治疗断掉的胳膊。
words.en: Surgery is the medical specialty that uses operative manual and instrumental techniques on a patient to investigate or treat a pathological condition such as a disease or injury, to help improve bodily function or appearance, or to repair unwanted ruptured areas.

words.ex: The survival of the animals depends on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这些动物的生存取决于天气。
words.en: The state or fact of continuing to live or exist, typically in spite of an accident, ordeal, or difficult circumstances.

words.tr: n. 综合征；综合症状；典型表现；
words.ex: He was diagnosed with sleep apnea syndrome.
words.ex_cn: 他被诊断出患有睡眠呼吸暂停综合征。
words.en: A syndrome is a set of medical signs and symptoms which are correlated with each other and often associated with a particular disease or disorder.

words.ex: He has a high fever as a symptom of the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧是流感的症状。
words.en: A symptom is a physical or mental feature which is regarded as indicating a condition of disease, particularly such a feature that is apparent to the patient.

words.ex: He poured syrup on his pancakes.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖浆倒在煎饼上。
words.en: A thick, sweet liquid made by dissolving sugar in boiling water, often used as a topping for desserts or as a sweetener in drinks.

words.tr: n. 平板电脑；（刻有文字的）匾；
words.ex: He uses a tablet to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他用平板电脑读书。
words.en: A tablet is a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen. It can also refer to a small, solid piece of medicine that you swallow.

words.ex: The nurse takes her temperature every morning.
words.ex_cn: 护士每天早上给她量体温。
words.en: To measure someone's body temperature, usually to check for fever.

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.ex: He is receiving therapy for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受治疗以缓解背痛。
words.en: Therapy is the treatment of someone with mental or physical illness without the use of drugs or operations.

words.tr:
n. 脚趾
v. 用脚尖触
words.ex: He touched the ball with his toe.
words.ex_cn: 他用脚趾碰了球。
words.en: One of the five digits at the end of the foot, or the similar part of a shoe or sock.

words.ex: He has a toothache and cannot eat.
words.ex_cn: 他牙疼，不能吃东西。
words.en: A toothache is a pain in or around a tooth.

words.ex: The doctor gave him proper treatment for the infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他提供了针对感染的适当治疗。
words.en: The act or manner of treating someone or something, especially in a medical context.

words.tr:
n. 麻烦；问题；困难；
v. 费神；
words.ex: He got into trouble for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而惹上了麻烦。
words.en: If you say that someone is in trouble, you mean that they are in a situation that is difficult to deal with and that may cause them problems.

words.ex: He gave the rope a twist to tie it tight.
words.ex_cn: 他把绳子拧了一下以便系紧。
words.en: To twist something means to turn it in a different direction or to change its shape by turning it.

words.tr: adj. 不卫生的，不干净的；
words.ex: The kitchen was unhygienic and full of dirt.
words.ex_cn: 厨房很不卫生，到处都是脏东西。
words.en: If you describe something as unhygienic, you mean that it is dirty and likely to cause illness or disease.

words.ex: He got a vaccine last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周打了疫苗。
words.en: A vaccine is a substance containing a virus or bacterium in a form that is not harmful, given to a person or animal to prevent them from getting the disease that the virus or bacterium causes.

words.ex: The veterinarian helps sick animals.
words.ex_cn: 兽医帮助生病的动物。
words.en: A veterinarian is a person who is qualified to treat sick or injured animals.

words.tr:
n. 兽医；
v. 审查；
words.ex: The vet checked the dog's health.
words.ex_cn: 兽医检查了狗的健康状况。
words.en: A vet is a person who is qualified to treat sick or injured animals. As a verb, to vet means to examine something or someone carefully to make sure they are suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The virus made many people sick.
words.ex_cn: 这个病毒让很多人病了。
words.en: A virus is a very small organism that causes infectious diseases in people, animals, and plants.

words.ex: Eating fruits gives you vitamin C.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果可以给你维生素C。
words.en: A vitamin is one of a group of organic substances which are essential in small quantities to the nutrition of most animals and some plants, and which are present in natural foodstuffs or sometimes produced within the body.

words.ex: He measured his waist with a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他用卷尺测量了自己的腰围。
words.en: Your waist is the middle part of your body where it narrows slightly above your hips.

words.ex: He joined a weight loss program to get healthier.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个减肥计划以变得更健康。
words.en: A weight loss program is a structured plan designed to help individuals reduce their body weight, typically through a combination of diet, exercise, and sometimes behavioral changes.

words.tr: n. 伤口；创伤； v. “wind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He cleaned the wound with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水清洗了伤口。
words.en: A wound is damage to part of your body, especially a cut or a hole in your flesh, which is caused by a gun, knife, or other weapon.

words.ex: He hurt his wrist while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他打篮球时伤了手腕。
words.en: The part of your body where your hand joins your arm.

words.ex: He got yellow fever while traveling in Africa.
words.ex_cn: 他在非洲旅行时感染了黄热病。
words.en: Yellow fever is a serious viral disease that is transmitted by mosquitoes, primarily in tropical regions of Africa and South America. It is characterized by fever, chills, severe headache, back pain, general body aches, nausea, and vomiting. In severe cases, it can cause liver damage leading to jaundice (which gives the disease its name), bleeding, and even death.

words.ex: He showed his admission card to borrow a book.
words.ex_cn: 他出示了他的借书证来借书。
words.en: A ticket or pass that allows someone to enter a place or event.

words.ex: He read an anthology of short stories last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了一本短篇故事选集。
words.en: An anthology is a collection of writings, such as poems or stories, that have been chosen by someone because they are considered to be the best or most interesting examples of their kind.

words.ex: He wrote an article about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or online. It can also refer to a particular item or object, or a clause in a legal document.

words.tr: phrase. 音频实验室；声音实验室
words.ex: The students listen to English in the audio laboratory.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在语音实验室听英语。
words.en: A facility equipped for the production, analysis, and testing of audio and sound technologies.

words.ex: The school has a well-equipped audio-visual resource centre.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个设备齐全的视听资源中心。
words.en: A place where audio and visual materials are stored and made available for use, typically in an educational or institutional setting.

words.ex: He is the author of this book.
words.ex_cn: 他是这本书的作者。
words.en: An author is a person who writes books, stories, or articles, especially as a job.

words.ex: He wrote his autobiography when he was 70.
words.ex_cn: 他70岁时写了自传。
words.en: An autobiography is a book about the life of a person, written by that person.

words.tr: phrase. 过期的期刊；往期杂志
words.ex: He bought a back issue of the magazine.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一本往期的杂志。
words.en: A back issue refers to a past edition of a magazine, journal, or other periodical that is no longer the current issue.

words.ex: He read a biography of Nelson Mandela.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于纳尔逊·曼德拉的传记。
words.en: A biography is a detailed description of a person's life. It involves more than just the basic facts like education, work, relationships, and death; it portrays a person's experience of these life events.

words.ex: We booked in advance to get good seats.
words.ex_cn: 我们提前预订了座位，以便得到好位置。
words.en: To arrange for something to be reserved or secured at a time before it is needed.

words.ex: He put his books on the bookshelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在书架上。
words.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for storing books.

words.ex: He picked up a brochure about the city.
words.ex_cn: 他拿了一本关于这座城市的宣传小册子。
words.en: A brochure is a type of small magazine or booklet containing pictures and information about something or advertising something.

words.ex: He handed out a leaflet about the event.
words.ex_cn: 他分发了一份关于该活动的传单。
words.en: A leaflet is a small sheet of printed paper that gives you information or advertises something.

words.ex: He handed me a pamphlet about the new park.
words.ex_cn: 他递给我一份关于新公园的小册子。
words.en: A pamphlet is a small book containing information on a particular subject or expressing political or religious views.

words.ex: He read the booklet about the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 他读了那本关于新规则的小册子。
words.en: A booklet is a small, thin book that has a paper cover and that gives you information about something.

words.ex: He uses a card index to store phone numbers.
words.ex_cn: 他用卡片索引来存储电话号码。
words.en: A card index is a system of organizing information on cards, which are stored in a box or cabinet and can be searched through easily.

words.ex: He played his favorite song on a cassette player.
words.ex_cn: 他用盒式磁带播放器播放了他最喜欢的歌。
words.en: A cassette is a small flat case containing a very long strip of magnetic material that is used to record sound or pictures.

words.ex: He looked at the catalogue to find the book.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看目录来找那本书。
words.en: A catalogue is a list of things such as the goods you can buy from a particular company, the objects in a museum, or the books in a library.

words.ex: This book belongs to the science category.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于科学类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.tr: n. 清单；检查表；备忘录；目录册；
words.ex: He made a checklist for his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为旅行列了一份清单。
words.en: A checklist is a list of items required, things to be done, or points to be considered, used as a reminder.

words.ex: The circulation of blood keeps us alive.
words.ex_cn: 血液的循环让我们活着。
words.en: The movement of something such as money or goods from place to place or from person to person; the number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are sold.

words.ex: He returned the book at the circulation desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在借还书台归还了这本书。
words.en: The circulation desk is the place in a library where you can borrow and return books.

words.ex: The teacher gave a classification of animals into mammals and birds.
words.ex_cn: 老师将动物分为哺乳动物和鸟类。
words.en: The action or process of classifying something according to shared qualities or characteristics.

words.ex: The book is in the closed reserve at the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆的闭架阅览区。
words.en: A state of being reserved or restrained, often due to shyness or caution.

words.ex: He uses a color copier to print his pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他使用彩色复印机打印他的照片。
words.en: A machine that makes copies of documents or images in color.

words.tr: phrase. 计算机终端，一种用于输入和输出数据的电子设备，通常连接到主机或服务器
words.ex: He uses a computer terminal to log in.
words.ex_cn: 他使用计算机终端登录。
words.en: A device with a screen and keyboard for interacting with a computer, often in a public or shared setting.

words.ex: The copier is broken, so we can't make copies.
words.ex_cn: 复印机坏了，所以我们不能复印了。
words.en: A copier is a machine that makes paper copies of documents and other visual images quickly and cheaply.

words.ex: He uses the copy machine to make papers.
words.ex_cn: 他使用复印机来复印纸张。
words.en: A machine that makes copies of documents and other visual images quickly and cheaply.

words.ex: He uses the course book for his English class.
words.ex_cn: 他用这本教材上英语课。
words.en: A course book is a textbook used in a course of study.

words.ex: The library has the latest current issue of the magazine.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆有这本杂志的最新现期刊物。
words.en: The most recent edition of a newspaper, magazine, or journal.

words.ex: The school stores student records in a database.
words.ex_cn: 学校将学生记录存储在数据库中。
words.en: A database is a collection of data that is organized so that it can easily be accessed, managed, and updated.

words.tr: phrase. 终止日期；借书期限
words.ex: The date of expiry is tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 到期日期是明天。
words.en: The date on which something, especially a contract, agreement, or product, is no longer valid or usable.

words.ex: He returned the book at the delivery desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在借书台还了书。
words.en: A place in a building where you can collect or arrange for the delivery of items.

words.ex: He writes in his diary every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都写日记。
words.en: A diary is a book in which you write down your personal experiences and thoughts each day.

words.ex: I looked up the word in a dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在词典里查了这个词。
words.en: A dictionary is a book in which the words of a language are listed alphabetically, together with their meanings, pronunciations, and other information.

words.ex: The digital system shows the time on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 这个数字系统在屏幕上显示时间。
words.en: A digital system is a system that uses discrete values, often binary numbers, for input, processing, transmission, storage, or display, as opposed to an analog system which uses continuous signals.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.tr: adj. 应给的；预期的；到期的；
words.ex: The payment is due tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 这笔款项明天应给。
words.en: If something is due at a particular time, it is expected to happen or be done at that time.

words.tr: phrase. 到期日；截止日期；预产期
words.ex: The due date for the homework is Friday.
words.ex_cn: 作业的截止日期是星期五。
words.en: The date by which something is expected to happen or be completed.

words.ex: He looked up the word in an encyclopedia.
words.ex_cn: 他从百科全书中查找这个词。
words.en: An encyclopedia is a book or set of books giving information on many subjects or on many aspects of one subject and typically arranged alphabetically.

words.ex: The milk's expiry date is tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 这瓶牛奶的保质期是明天。
words.en: The date on which something, especially a contract or agreement, comes to an end or ceases to be valid.

words.ex: He loves reading science fiction.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Fiction refers to literature in the form of prose, especially novels, that describes imaginary events and people.

words.tr:
adj. 很好的；晴朗的；健康的；
n. 罚款；
words.ex: She did a fine job on the project.
words.ex_cn: 她在这个项目上做得很好。
words.en: If you say that something is fine, you mean that it is satisfactory or acceptable.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的系统；精密的系统
words.ex: The school has a fine system for helping students learn.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个帮助学生学习的良好系统。
words.en: A system of imposing monetary penalties as a punishment for breaking laws or rules.

words.ex: He keeps a hand book for daily tips.
words.ex_cn: 他随身携带一本手册记录日常小贴士。
words.en: A small reference book providing information or instructions on a specific subject.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handout about photosynthesis.
words.ex_cn: 老师发给我们一份关于光合作用的讲义。
words.en: A handout is a document which contains news or information about something and which is given, for example, to journalists or to people attending a talk or lecture.

words.ex: The index of 2 in 2^3 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 2^3 中 2 的指数是 3。
words.en: An index is a system by which changes in the value of something and the rate at which it changes can be recorded, measured, or interpreted.

words.ex: He asked for help at the information desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在信息台寻求帮助。
words.en: A place in a public building where you can go to get information.

words.tr: phrase. 问询处；咨询台；服务台
words.ex: He asked for help at the inquiry desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在问询处寻求帮助。
words.en: A desk or counter in a public place where you can go to ask for information.

words.tr: phrase. 图书馆馆际互借服务
words.ex: The library offers an interlibrary service to borrow books from other libraries.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆提供馆际服务，可以从其他图书馆借书。
words.en: A service allowing libraries to borrow materials from other libraries on behalf of their patrons.

words.tr: phrase. 互联网接入；上网权限；网络连接
words.ex: He has internet access at home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家有网络访问。
words.en: The ability to connect to the internet, allowing users to browse websites, send emails, and use online services.

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.tr: n. 便携式电脑；笔记本电脑；
words.ex: He uses a laptop to work from home.
words.ex_cn: 他用笔记本电脑在家工作。
words.en: A laptop is a computer which is small enough to be carried around easily and is designed for use outside an office.

words.ex: The librarian helps students find books.
words.ex_cn: 图书管理员帮助学生找书。
words.en: A librarian is a person who is in charge of a library or who has been trained to do this work.

words.ex: He uses his library card to borrow books.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的借书证借书。
words.en: A library card is a card issued by a library to individuals, entitling them to borrow books and other materials.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.tr: phrase. 借阅期；贷款期限；借出期间
words.ex: The loan period for books is two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的借阅期是两周。
words.en: The duration for which something, especially a book from a library, is borrowed.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.ex: He reads a magazine every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上读一本杂志。
words.en: A magazine is a type of thin book with large pages and a paper cover which contains articles, photographs, and advertisements, usually on a particular subject or aimed at a particular readership.

words.tr:
adj. 手工的；体力的；
n. 说明书；
words.ex: He made a manual copy of the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他手工抄写了一封信。
words.en: A manual is a book which tells you how to do something or how a piece of machinery works.

words.ex: He used microfilm to save old newspapers.
words.ex_cn: 他使用微缩胶片保存旧报纸。
words.en: Microfilm is a film on which documents or printed materials are photographed at a greatly reduced size for ease of storage.

words.ex: It's a myth that eating late at night causes weight gain.
words.ex_cn: 晚上吃东西会导致发胖，这是一种错误观念。
words.en: A myth is a traditional story, especially one concerning the early history of a people or explaining some natural or social phenomenon, and typically involving supernatural beings or events.

words.ex: He reads the newspaper every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读报纸。
words.en: A newspaper is a publication consisting of a number of large sheets of folded paper, on which news, advertisements, and other information is printed.

words.ex: This document is not for circulation.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件不得外传。
words.en: This term is used to denote items, especially currency or documents, that are not intended for general distribution or use among the public.

words.tr:
n. （长篇）小说；
adj. 新颖的；新奇的；
words.ex: He wrote a novel about a brave girl.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一部关于一个勇敢女孩的小说。
words.en: A novel is a long written story about imaginary people and events.

words.tr: phrase. 不在流通的；不再活跃的；不参与社交活动的
words.ex: That coin is out of circulation now.
words.ex_cn: 那枚硬币现在不再流通了。
words.en: If something is out of circulation, it is no longer available or no longer being used or seen in public.

words.ex: The book is overdue at the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆逾期了。
words.en: If you say that a change or an event is overdue, you mean that you think it should have happened before now.

words.ex: He must pay the fine for parking illegally.
words.ex_cn: 他必须支付因非法停车而产生的罚款。
words.en: To pay the fine means to give money as a penalty for breaking a law or rule.

words.tr:
adj. 周期的；定期的
n. 期刊
words.ex: The plant has a periodical blooming cycle.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物有周期性的开花周期。
words.en: A periodical is a magazine, especially one that is published regularly, or something that happens at regular intervals.

words.ex: The photocopier broke down this morning.
words.ex_cn: 这台复印机今天早上坏了。
words.en: A photocopier is a machine that makes copies of documents or pictures by photographing them.

words.tr:
v. 玩；扮演；演奏；播放；
n. 戏剧；比赛；
words.ex: The children play in the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在公园里玩。
words.en: When children, animals, or perhaps adults play, they spend time doing enjoyable things, such as using toys and taking part in games. When you play a sport, game, or match, you take part in it. Play is also a noun referring to a dramatic work or performance.

words.ex: He wrote a short poem for his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他为母亲写了一首短诗。
words.en: A poem is a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their beauty and sound and are carefully arranged, often in short lines which rhyme.

words.ex: He loves reading poetry before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在睡前读诗歌。
words.en: Poetry is the expression of ideas and feelings through the use of distinctive style and rhythm.

words.tr:
n. 新闻界；出版社；
v. 按；压；
words.ex: The press reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 新闻界迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: To press something is to push it firmly, often with your fingers or hand, in order to operate a device or machine, or to make something flat or smooth. It can also mean to urge someone to do something or to make a strong demand for something.

words.ex: The printer is out of paper.
words.ex_cn: 打印机没有纸了。
words.en: A printer is a machine that can be connected to a computer in order to make copies on paper of documents or other information held by the computer.

words.ex: The computer has a fast processor.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑有一个快速的处理器。
words.en: A processor is a part of a computer that interprets and carries out instructions.

words.ex: The publisher released a new book last month.
words.ex_cn: 出版者上个月发布了一本新书。
words.en: A publisher is a person or company that prepares and issues books, journals, or music for sale.

words.tr:
v. 回忆起；召回；
n. 记忆力；
words.ex: I recall my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我想起了我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

words.tr: phrase. 参考资料；参考材料；文献资料
words.ex: He uses reference material to find the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他使用参考资料来找到答案。
words.en: Reference material refers to any source of information that is used to support or provide evidence for a particular point or argument. It can include books, articles, databases, and other resources that are consulted during research or study.

words.tr: phrase. 参考书区；参考资料部分；文献引用部分
words.ex: He checked the reference section for the book.
words.ex_cn: 他去参考文献区查找那本书。
words.en: The part of a library where reference materials, such as encyclopedias and dictionaries, are kept for in-library use only.

words.tr: phrase. 参考栈；引用栈（计算机术语，指用于存储函数调用、变量引用或调试信息的内存区域）
words.ex: He checked the reference stack for the book.
words.ex_cn: 他去参考书架查找那本书。
words.en: A set of standard or benchmark materials used for comparison.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.ex: The renewal of the contract took one week.
words.ex_cn: 合同的更新花了一周时间。
words.en: The act of making something valid for a further period of time after it has expired or been canceled.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.tr: phrase. 保留区；预留部分；图书馆藏书保留区（仅供馆内阅览不外借的区域）
words.ex: He reserved a seat in the reserve section.
words.ex_cn: 他预订了预留区域的一个座位。
words.en: A designated area in a library where books are kept for specific use or borrowing.

words.tr: phrase. 在流通中被保留的；处于流通但受限制的
words.ex: The coins are reserved in circulation for collectors.
words.ex_cn: 这些硬币被保留用于收藏者流通。
words.en: Kept aside or retained within the flow or distribution of something, especially money or goods.

words.tr:
n. 返回；归还；
v. 返回；归还；
words.ex: The return of the train was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 火车的返回被推迟了。
words.en: To go or come back to a place or person. To give, send, or put something back to its original place or condition.

words.tr: phrase. 返回区域；回收区；退货区
words.ex: The return area is near the exit door.
words.ex_cn: 返回区域在出口门附近。
words.en: The designated section in a library or store where customers can bring back borrowed or purchased items.

words.ex: He uses a scanner to copy documents.
words.ex_cn: 他使用扫描仪来复制文件。
words.en: A scanner is a device that captures images from photographic prints, posters, magazine pages, and similar sources for computer editing and display.

words.ex: He bought a new textbook for math class.
words.ex_cn: 他为数学课买了一本新教科书。
words.en: A textbook is a book containing a comprehensive compilation of content in a branch of study with the intention of explaining it. Textbooks are produced to meet the needs of educators, usually at educational institutions.

words.ex: He typed the letter on an old typewriter.
words.ex_cn: 他用一台旧打字机打了这封信。
words.en: A typewriter is a machine with keys that you press to print letters, numbers, or other characters onto paper.

words.ex: He recorded the game on a video tape.
words.ex_cn: 他把比赛录在录像带上。
words.en: A video tape is a magnetic tape used for recording visual images and sound.

words.ex: The volume of the box is 10 cubic meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的体积是10立方米。
words.en: A volume is a book, especially one that is part of a series of books. It can also refer to the amount of space that a substance or object occupies, or the level of sound produced by a television, radio, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 文字处理软件；文字处理器（用于创建、编辑和格式化文本文档的计算机程序或设备）
words.ex: She uses a word processor to write her reports.
words.ex_cn: 她使用文字处理软件来写报告。
words.en: A word processor is a computer program used for creating, editing, and printing documents.

words.tr: n. 活页练习题；工作记录；工作表
words.ex: The teacher gave the students a worksheet for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们发了一份练习表作为家庭作业。
words.en: A worksheet is a piece of paper on which problems or tasks are set for students or workers to solve or complete.

words.tr: phrase. 成年学生；指在成年后继续接受教育的学生
words.ex: The adult student works during the day and goes to class at night.
words.ex_cn: 这位成年学生白天工作，晚上上课。
words.en: An adult who is enrolled in an educational program, typically at a college or university, often balancing studies with other responsibilities.

words.ex: She is an alumna of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 她是哈佛大学的校友。
words.en: An alumna is a female former student of a particular school, college, or university.

words.ex: Many alumnae returned to the university for the centennial celebration.
words.ex_cn: 许多女校友回到大学参加百年庆典。
words.en: Alumnae refers to female graduates or former students of a particular school, college, or university.

words.ex: He is an alumnus of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的男毕业生。
words.en: An alumnus is a former student of a particular school, college, or university.

words.ex: The school invited its alumni to the annual reunion.
words.ex_cn: 学校邀请了它的校友参加年度聚会。
words.en: Alumni are former students of a particular school, college, or university.

words.ex: The house has a small annex for storage.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个用于存放物品的小附属物。
words.en: To annex means to take control of a country, region, etc., especially by force; to add an area or region to a country, state, etc. : to take control of (a territory or place).

words.ex: The applicant filled out the form carefully.
words.ex_cn: 这位申请人仔细填写了表格。
words.en: An applicant is someone who applies for something, especially a job.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请银行的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请图书馆的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.ex: He is an assistant professor at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学里的一名助理教授。
words.en: An assistant professor is a college or university teacher of the lowest rank, who is working towards becoming a full professor.

words.tr: n. （大学）研究生助教奖学金
words.ex: He got an assistantship to help with research.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一份助教职位来协助研究。
words.en: An assistantship is a position of a graduate student that involves teaching or research duties in exchange for financial support.

words.ex: He is an associate professor at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的副教授。
words.en: An associate professor is a mid-level academic rank in universities and colleges, above assistant professor and below full professor.

words.tr: phrase. 副学士文凭；专科文凭（通常指完成两年制高等教育课程后获得的学位证书）
words.ex: He earned an associate diploma in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了计算机科学的副学士学位。
words.en: A qualification awarded after completing a two-year course of study, typically at a college or technical institute.

words.ex: He earned a bachelor's degree in biology.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了生物学学士学位。
words.en: A bachelor's degree is an undergraduate academic degree awarded by colleges and universities upon completion of a course of study lasting three to seven years (depending on institution and academic discipline).

words.ex: He lives in a boarding school far from home.
words.ex_cn: 他住在离家很远的寄宿学校。
words.en: A boarding school is a school where some or all pupils not only study but also live during term time, with their fellow students and possibly teachers.

words.ex: He keeps old toys in the box room.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧玩具放在储藏室里。
words.en: A small room in a house used for storing things, especially boxes and other items that are not frequently used.

words.tr: phrase. 商学院；商业系（指大学中教授商业和管理学科的院系）
words.ex: He works in the business faculty at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学的商学院工作。
words.en: The business faculty refers to the department within a university or college that focuses on the study of business and management.

words.ex: He is a candidate for the mayor position.
words.ex_cn: 他是市长职位的候选人。
words.en: A candidate is someone who is being considered for a position, for example someone who is running in an election or applying for a job.

words.ex: He went to the career advice centre to find a good job.
words.ex_cn: 他去职业咨询中心找一份好工作。
words.en: A place where individuals can receive guidance and support regarding their career choices and job searching strategies.

words.ex: He visited the career office to find a job.
words.ex_cn: 他去职业办公室找工作。
words.en: An office that provides advice and information on careers and job opportunities, often within an educational institution.

words.ex: He parked his car in the car park.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了停车场。
words.en: A car park is an area or building where people can leave their cars.

words.ex: He received a certificate for completing the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了课程后获得了证书。
words.en: A certificate is an official document attesting a fact, in particular.

words.ex: The chancellor announced a new tax policy.
words.ex_cn: 大臣宣布了一项新的税收政策。
words.en: A chancellor is the head of the government in some countries, or a high-ranking official in a university or other institution.

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.ex: He checks in at the hotel at 3 PM.
words.ex_cn: 他在下午三点办理入住。
words.en: To announce your arrival, especially at a hotel or an airport, by signing your name or showing your ticket.

words.ex: The new childcare centre opened last month.
words.ex_cn: 新的托儿所上个月开业了。
words.en: A childcare centre is a place where children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.ex: He works at a small college.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所小型学院工作。
words.en: A college is an institution where students study after they have left school, in order to get a degree or qualification.

words.tr: phrase. 社区学院（美国提供两年制高等教育的公立学院，通常授予副学士学位）
words.ex: She decided to attend a community college to save money.
words.ex_cn: 她决定去社区大学就读以节省学费。
words.en: A community college is a type of educational institution providing post-secondary education and lower-level tertiary education, granting certificates, diplomas, and associate's degrees.

words.tr: phrase. 综合性大学；涵盖多个学科领域的高等教育机构
words.ex: The comprehensive university offers a wide range of programs across various disciplines.
words.ex_cn: 这所综合性大学在多个学科领域提供广泛的项目。
words.en: A comprehensive university is an institution of higher education that offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs across various disciplines.

words.tr: phrase. 会议指南；会议资料册
words.ex: He received a conference pack with notes and a pen.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了一份包含笔记和一支笔的会议资料包。
words.en: A set of materials provided to attendees of a conference, typically including the agenda, speaker information, and other relevant documents.

words.ex: We met in the conference room to talk.
words.ex_cn: 我们在会议室里开会讨论。
words.en: A room designated for meetings or conferences, typically equipped with facilities such as a large table, chairs, and presentation equipment.

words.ex: She is the coordinator of the school event.
words.ex_cn: 她是学校活动的协调者。
words.en: A coordinator is someone whose job is to organize the various parts of an activity or the people involved in it so that it works efficiently.

words.tr: phrase. 咨询中心；辅导中心（提供心理、职业或教育等方面咨询服务的机构）
words.ex: The university has established a counselling centre to support students' mental health.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学设立了一个咨询中心来支持学生的心理健康。
words.en: A place where professional advice and support are provided to individuals who need help with personal, social, or psychological problems.

words.tr: phrase. 课程教师；授课老师
words.ex: The course teacher for the physics class is highly experienced.
words.ex_cn: 物理课的课程教师非常有经验。
words.en: An instructor or educator responsible for teaching a specific course or subject.

words.ex: The dean gave a speech at the graduation ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 院长在毕业典礼上发表了演讲。
words.en: A dean is a senior official in a college or university, who is in charge of a faculty or department or a group of students.

words.ex: The temperature is 30 degrees today.
words.ex_cn: 今天气温是30度。
words.en: A degree is a unit of measurement for angles, or a qualification given to a student by a college or university after they have completed a course of study.

words.ex: He works in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售部工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university.

words.ex: The deputy signed the document for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 代理人替经理签署了文件。
words.en: A deputy is a person who is appointed to act as a substitute for another, especially in a position of authority.

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.ex: He earned his doctor's degree in physics after five years of research.
words.ex_cn: 他经过五年的研究获得了物理学博士学位。
words.en: A doctor's degree is the highest level of academic degree awarded by universities, signifying the completion of advanced studies and research in a specific field.

words.tr: phrase. 本国学生；国内学生（指在本国接受教育而非国际或外国学生）
words.ex: The domestic student lives on campus.
words.ex_cn: 这名本国学生住在校园里。
words.en: A student who is a citizen or permanent resident of the country where they are studying, as opposed to an international student.

words.ex: He became a dropout after failing math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试不及格后退学了。
words.en: A dropout is a person who leaves school or college before they have finished their studies, especially because they are not interested in continuing.

words.ex: The education department sends books to schools.
words.ex_cn: 教育部门向学校发送书籍。
words.en: The department of a government or organization responsible for the administration and oversight of education systems and policies.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的；合意的；
words.ex: He is eligible to vote because he is 18 years old.
words.ex_cn: 他年满18岁，有资格投票。
words.en: Someone who is eligible for something is qualified or allowed to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 有资格的；符合某事的条件
words.ex: He is eligible for a scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 他有资格获得奖学金。
words.en: To have the right to do or obtain something through satisfying the appropriate conditions.

words.ex: He went to elementary school in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他曾在纽约上小学。
words.en: An elementary school is a school for children in their first few years of education, especially those between the ages of 5 and 11.

words.ex: He works in the engineering faculty at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学的工程学院工作。
words.en: The engineering faculty refers to the department or division within a university that is dedicated to the study and teaching of engineering disciplines.

words.ex: He works at an engineering institute.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所工程学院工作。
words.en: An educational institution that specializes in teaching and research in various fields of engineering.

words.ex: He will enrol in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将登记参加英语课程。
words.en: To officially arrange to join a school, university, or course, or to arrange for someone else to do this.

words.ex: He will enroll in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将注册英语课程。
words.en: To officially register or enlist oneself or someone else in a course, institution, or organization.

words.ex: His enrolment at the university starts next month.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学的入学时间是下个月。
words.en: Enrolment refers to the process of signing up or registering for something, such as a school, course, or program.

words.tr: n. 入会；入学 ；登记；注册；加入人数
words.ex: His enrollment in the club was approved last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周被批准加入该俱乐部。
words.en: The act of officially joining a course, school, etc., or the number of people who do this.

words.tr: phrase. 入学要求；准入条件
words.ex: The entry requirement for this school is a high school diploma.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的入学要求是高中文凭。
words.en: The conditions that must be met in order to be admitted into a school, program, or event.

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He passed the exam with high marks.
words.ex_cn: 他以高分通过了考试。
words.en: An exam is a formal test that you take to show your knowledge or ability in a particular subject, or to obtain a qualification.

words.ex: He is an exchange student from Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名来自日本的交换生。
words.en: A student who goes to a foreign country to live and study for a period of time, often as part of an organized program.

words.ex: The family reduced their monthly expenditure.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭减少了每月的开支。
words.en: Expenditure is the spending of money on something, or the money that is spent on something.

words.ex: The expense of the trip was higher than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的费用比预期的要高。
words.en: An expense is the amount of money that you spend on something.

words.tr:
n. 专家；行家；
adj. 内行的；老练的；专门的；
words.ex: He is an expert in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他是计算机科学方面的专家。
words.en: A person who is very knowledgeable about or skillful in a particular area.

words.tr: n. 设施；特色功能；特定场所；资质；
words.ex: The school has a new sports facility.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个新的体育设施。
words.en: A facility is a place, building, or service that is designed for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The faculty of engineering has many labs.
words.ex_cn: 工程学院有许多实验室。
words.en: A faculty is a group of departments in a university or college that specialize in a particular subject or group of subjects, or the teachers in such a group.

words.ex: The faculty head gave a speech at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 系主任在会议上发表了演讲。
words.en: The faculty head is the person in charge of a specific department within a university or college, responsible for overseeing the academic and administrative functions of the department.

words.ex: He paid the fee to join the club.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了加入俱乐部的费用。
words.en: A fee is a sum of money that you pay to be allowed to do something such as join an organization, or to be given advice or a service.

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；情谊；团体；联谊会；研究生奖学金
words.ex: They formed a fellowship to work on the project together.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了伙伴关系一起来做这个项目。
words.en: A fellowship is a group of people who join together for a common purpose or interest, or a financial grant given to a scholar to allow them to study or research at an advanced level.

words.ex: He stored the documents in a metal file.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件存放在一个金属档案盒里。
words.en: A file is a box or folded piece of heavy paper or plastic in which letters or documents are kept. As a verb, to file means to put documents in a file or to officially record something.

words.tr: phrase. 大四学生；四年级学生
words.ex: He is a fourth-year student at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的四年级学生。
words.en: A student in their fourth year of study at a college or university.

words.ex: He is a freshman at university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的一名新生。
words.en: A freshman is a student in the first year of high school, college, or university.

words.ex: He is a full-time student at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学里的一名全日制学生。
words.en: A full-time student is someone who is enrolled in a post-secondary institution and is taking a minimum number of credit hours, typically 12 or more, per semester.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.ex: He wants to go to graduate school after college.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学毕业后读研究生院。
words.en: A graduate school is a school that awards advanced academic degrees (such as master's and doctoral degrees) with the general requirement that students must have earned a previous undergraduate (bachelor's) degree.

words.tr: n. …年级学生；平地机；分类机；分类者
words.ex: He is a fifth grader at Maple School.
words.ex_cn: 他是枫树小学五年级的学生。
words.en: A grader is a person who grades something, such as a teacher grading exams, or a machine used in construction for leveling the ground.

words.tr:
n. 补助金；授予物；
v. 承认；授予；允许；
words.ex: The university received a grant for scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学收到了一笔用于科学研究的补助金。
words.en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it or do it.

words.ex: The headmaster welcomed the new students.
words.ex_cn: 校长欢迎新生。
words.en: A headmaster is the man who is the head teacher of a school.

words.ex: The head teacher talked to my parents about my grades.
words.ex_cn: 班主任跟我父母谈了我的成绩。
words.en: The head teacher is the teacher who is in charge of a school.

words.tr: phrase. 卫生保健；健康护理
words.ex: He works in health care as a nurse.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名护士从事医疗工作。
words.en: Health care refers to the organized provision of medical care to individuals or a community.

words.ex: He wants to go to higher education after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在高中后接受高等教育。
words.en: Higher education refers to the level of study that is undertaken at universities, colleges, and institutes of technology, beyond the level of secondary education.

words.ex: The city plans to build a new hi-tech centre to attract startups.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市计划建立一个新的高科技中心以吸引初创企业。
words.en: A hi-tech centre is a facility or area designed to foster innovation and development in high technology sectors.

words.tr: phrase. 信息行业；信息产业
words.ex: The information sector grows fast in this country.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的信息产业增长很快。
words.en: The part of the economy that involves the production, processing, and distribution of information.

words.ex: The city needs better infrastructure for roads and water.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要更好的道路和供水设施。
words.en: The basic physical and organizational structures and facilities (e.g., buildings, roads, power supplies) needed for the operation of a society or enterprise.

words.tr:
n. 研究所；学院；协会；
v. 建立；制定；
words.ex: He works at a research institute.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家研究所工作。
words.en: An institute is an organization set up to do a particular type of work, especially research or teaching. It can also refer to the act of starting something such as a system or an official process.

words.ex: The international student lives in the dormitory.
words.ex_cn: 这位国际学生住在宿舍里。
words.en: A student from a country other than the one in which they are studying.

words.tr:
adj. （职位或等级）较低的；年幼的；（高中、大学的）三年级学生；
n. 年幼者；
words.ex: He is a junior employee in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是公司里职位较低的员工。
words.en: A junior person is younger or has a lower position than another person.

words.tr: phrase. 初级中学（通常指7至9年级）
words.ex: He goes to junior high school near his house.
words.ex_cn: 他去家附近的一所初中。
words.en: A school intermediate between elementary school and high school, typically including grades seven through nine.

words.tr: phrase. 重点大学；关键高校
words.ex: He got into a key university last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年上了一所重点大学。
words.en: A key university refers to a university that is considered to be of high importance or prestige, often due to its academic excellence, research output, or historical significance.

words.ex: He goes to kindergarten every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上上幼儿园。
words.en: A kindergarten is a school or class for young children, usually between the ages of four and six.

words.ex: He works in a laboratory on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 他在星期五去实验室工作。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific research, experiments, or teaching.

words.ex: The students do experiments in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在实验室做实验。
words.en: A lab is a place where scientific experiments and research are conducted.

words.ex: He asked his teacher for a letter of recommendation.
words.ex_cn: 他请老师写一封推荐信。
words.en: A letter of recommendation is a letter in which the writer describes the qualities, skills, and achievements of a person they know well, with the purpose of supporting that person's application for a job, admission to a school, or other opportunities.

words.tr: phrase. 生活费用；日常开销
words.ex: The living cost in the city is high.
words.ex_cn: 城市里的生活成本很高。
words.en: The amount of money needed to sustain a certain standard of living, including basics such as housing, food, taxes, and healthcare.

words.tr: phrase. 本地学生；当地学生
words.ex: The local student walks to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 这名本地学生每天步行上学。
words.en: A student who is from or lives in the area near the institution they attend, as opposed to an international or out-of-state student.

words.ex: The players go to the locker room after the game.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，球员们去更衣室。
words.en: A locker room is a room, especially in a sports facility, where people can change their clothes and store their belongings in lockers.

words.ex: The children play in the main square.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在主广场上玩耍。
words.en: The main square is a large open area in the center of a town or city, often used for public events or gatherings.

words.ex: He earned a master's degree in engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了工程学的硕士学位。
words.en: A master's degree is an advanced academic degree awarded by universities or colleges upon completion of a course of study demonstrating mastery or a high-order overview of a specific field of study or area of professional practice.

words.tr: phrase. 成年学生（指年龄较大、通常已离校多年后再进入高等院校就读的人）
words.ex: He is a mature student who returned to university at age 35.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名35岁重返大学的成年学生。
words.en: A mature student is an adult who returns to education, typically after a period of time spent working or raising a family.

words.ex: He went to the medical centre for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去医疗中心做检查。
words.en: A medical centre is a building or group of buildings where medical services are provided to the public.

words.ex: He studies at a medical university.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所医科大学学习。
words.en: An institution of higher education that focuses on training students in the field of medicine and health sciences.

words.ex: My mentor helped me choose my career path.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮助我选择了职业道路。
words.en: A mentor is a person who gives a younger or less experienced person help and advice over a period of time, especially at work or school.

words.tr: phrase. 师范大学（专指培养师资的高等院校）
words.ex: She attended a normal university to become a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 她上了一所师范大学，成为了一名教师。
words.en: A normal university is a type of university that specializes in training teachers for primary and secondary education.

words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.tr: phrase. 客观考试；标准化考试（答案唯一、评分不受主观影响的测验）
words.ex: He took an objective exam with multiple choice questions.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一次有选择题的客观考试。
words.en: An objective exam is a test that consists of factual questions requiring short answers that can be quickly and unambiguously scored by anyone with an answer key, thus minimizing subjective judgments by the person grading the test.

words.tr: phrase. 开卷考试（允许查阅教材或笔记的考试）
words.ex: He took an open-book exam in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上参加了一次开卷考试。
words.en: An open-book exam is a test where students are allowed to use textbooks, notes, and other materials. It assesses the ability to apply knowledge rather than memorize information.

words.tr: n. 入学介绍；岗前训练；方向；取向；
words.ex: The school held an orientation for new students on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 学校在周一为新生举行了入学介绍。
words.en: The act of orienting or the state of being oriented; the determination of the relative position of something or someone (especially oneself).

words.tr: phrase. 新生入学指导日；迎新日
words.ex: Students meet on orientation day to learn about the school.
words.ex_cn: 学生在迎新日认识学校。
words.en: An orientation day is a day set aside for welcoming and introducing new students or employees to an institution or organization, providing them with information about the environment, policies, and resources available to them.

words.tr: phrase. 迎新介绍会；新生指导讲座
words.ex: The new students attended an orientation talk on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新生们在周一参加了迎新讲座。
words.en: A talk or meeting designed to introduce someone to a new environment, organization, or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 新生/新员工导向参观；熟悉环境的导览
words.ex: We took an orientation tour of the school on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周一参加了学校的迎新参观。
words.en: A guided tour designed to introduce newcomers to a new environment, such as a workplace, school, or city, highlighting key locations and facilities.

words.ex: New students join orientation week to learn about the school.
words.ex_cn: 新生参加迎新周以了解学校。
words.en: A week at the beginning of a university term, during which a series of events are organized to introduce new students to the university and to help them settle in.

words.ex: The overseas student lives in a dormitory.
words.ex_cn: 这位留学生住在宿舍里。
words.en: A student who comes from a foreign country to study in another country.

words.tr:
v. 包装；收拾行李；
n. 包裹；小包；
words.ex: She packs the gift in colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩纸包装礼物。
words.en: A pack is a container of a particular kind, especially one made of strong paper or plastic and containing a number of the same items. As a verb, pack means to put something into a container, especially in a neat and efficient way.

words.tr:
n. 包；包裹；
v. 包装；
words.ex: He bought a package of cookies.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一包饼干。
words.en: A package is a wrapped container or a set of objects wrapped in paper or packed in a box.

words.tr: phrase. 包装材料；填充物；打包用的物料
words.ex: The box was filled with packing material.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子装满了包装材料。
words.en: Material used to protect or cushion items during shipping or storage.

words.ex: Parental teaching helps children learn good habits.
words.ex_cn: 父母的教导帮助孩子养成好习惯。
words.en: The act or process of imparting knowledge, skills, and values from parents to their children.

words.tr: phrase. 兼职学生；非全日制学生
words.ex: He is a part-time student who works in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名兼职学生，晚上工作。
words.en: A part-time student is someone who is enrolled in a course of study but does not attend classes full-time, often because they are working or have other commitments.

words.ex: The car is in the parking lot.
words.ex_cn: 车在停车场里。
words.en: A parking lot is an area of ground where people can leave their cars.

words.tr:
n. 同辈；同等的人；
v. 凝视；
words.ex: He feels comfortable talking to his peers.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得和同辈交谈很自在。
words.en: A peer is someone who is equal to another in abilities, qualifications, age, background, or social status. As a verb, to peer means to look keenly or with difficulty at someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 个人导师；私人导师
words.ex: He has a personal tutor to help him with math.
words.ex_cn: 他请了一位私人导师来帮他学习数学。
words.en: A personal tutor is someone who gives private lessons to a student, often to help them with a particular subject or to prepare for an exam.

words.ex: He works in the physics laboratory every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午都在物理实验室工作。
words.en: A physics laboratory is a facility where experiments and research in the field of physics are conducted.

words.ex: He took a placement test to join the advanced class.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一次分班测试，以便进入高级班。
words.en: A placement test is a test usually given to a student entering an educational institution to determine the level of knowledge or proficiency in a particular subject or subjects.

words.tr: phrase. 游乐中心；儿童游乐场
words.ex: The children spent the afternoon at the play centre.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在游乐中心度过了一个下午。
words.en: A play centre is a place designed for children to play, often indoors, with various games and activities.

words.tr: n. 工艺专科学院；理工专科学院；
words.ex: He enrolled in a polytechnic to learn engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他进入了一所工艺专科学院学习工程。
words.en: A polytechnic is an institution of higher education offering courses in many subjects, especially vocational or technical subjects.

words.tr:
n. 研究生；
adj. 大学毕业后的；
words.ex: He is a postgraduate at Beijing University.
words.ex_cn: 他是北京大学的一名研究生。
words.en: A postgraduate is a student who continues studying after obtaining a first degree, usually in order to obtain a higher qualification.

words.ex: He earned a postgraduate diploma in education.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了教育学研究生文凭。
words.en: A postgraduate diploma is a qualification awarded typically after a bachelor's degree, which is more advanced than a bachelor's degree but less so than a master's degree.

words.ex: The president signed the new contract.
words.ex_cn: 总裁签署了新合同。
words.en: The president is the elected head of a republic or the head of a company or organization.

words.ex: He taught math in primary school.
words.ex_cn: 他在小学教数学。
words.en: A primary school is a school for children between the ages of about five and eleven.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；最重要的；
n. 校长；负责人；
words.ex: The principal reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The person with the highest authority or most important position in an organization, institution, or group.

words.ex: The professor teaches physics at the university.
words.ex_cn: 这位教授在大学教物理。
words.en: A professor is a senior teacher in a college or university.

words.ex: The proofreader meticulously checked the manuscript for errors.
words.ex_cn: 校对者一丝不苟地检查手稿中的错误。
words.en: A proofreader is someone whose job is to check written texts for errors before they are published.

words.ex: The pupil writes with a pencil in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个小学生在课堂上用铅笔写字。
words.en: A pupil is a child or young person who is being taught in a school or by a private tutor.

words.ex: He got a teaching qualification last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了教师资格。
words.en: A qualification is a skill or type of experience that you need in order to do a particular job or activity.

words.ex: The students participated in a history quiz at school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们参加了学校举办的历史知识竞赛。
words.en: A quiz is a test or a game in which someone asks you questions to find out how much you know about a subject.

words.ex: The teacher asked us to reexamine our answers before submitting the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师让我们在交卷前重新审视我们的答案。
words.en: To examine something again, especially in order to check for mistakes or to consider new information.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.tr: n. 裁判；介绍人；仲裁者
words.ex: The referee blew the whistle for a foul.
words.ex_cn: 裁判吹哨判罚犯规。
words.en: A referee is an official who watches a game or match closely to ensure that the rules are adhered to and sometimes to arbitrate on matters arising from the play.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.tr: phrase. 注册学生；已注册的学生
words.ex: He is a registered student at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是这所大学的注册学生。
words.en: A registered student is someone who has officially enrolled in a course or institution.

words.ex: The resident student lives on campus.
words.ex_cn: 这名住校学生住在校园里。
words.en: A student who lives in the school or college dormitory.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.tr: phrase. 艺术学院；文艺学院
words.ex: He went to the school of arts to learn painting.
words.ex_cn: 他去艺术学院学习绘画。
words.en: A division or department within a university or college that offers courses and degrees in the arts, such as fine arts, music, drama, or literature.

words.ex: He is studying at the school of law.
words.ex_cn: 他正在法学院学习。
words.en: An institution where students study law at a university level.

words.ex: He works in the school of sciences at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学的理学院工作。
words.en: A school of sciences is an institution or department within a university that focuses on the study and research of scientific disciplines.

words.ex: He teaches math in a secondary school.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所中学教数学。
words.en: A secondary school is a school for pupils between the ages of 11 or 12 and 18.

words.ex: Students use the self-access lab to practice English.
words.ex_cn: 学生使用自主学习实验室练习英语。
words.en: A self-access lab is a facility provided by educational institutions where students can engage in independent learning activities, often with the use of computers and other resources.

words.tr:
adj. 资深的；高级的；年长的；
n. 年长者；大四学生；
words.ex: He is a senior engineer with 20 years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有20年经验的资深工程师。
words.en: Higher in rank, status, or importance; older in age.

words.tr: phrase. 高级顾问；资深督导师
words.ex: He is a senior advisor at the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是这家公司的高级顾问。
words.en: A senior advisor is a person who provides expert advice to an organization or individual, often in a specific field or area of expertise.

words.tr: phrase. 高中（指中学的最后几年，通常为10至12年级）
words.ex: He is studying in senior high school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在上高中。
words.en: A senior high school is a school for students in their final years of secondary education, typically between the ages of 15 and 18.

words.tr: n. 样品陈列室；展销厅；
words.ex: The car showroom has many new models on display.
words.ex_cn: 汽车样品陈列室里有许多新款车型展出。
words.en: A showroom is a large room used for displaying goods, especially cars, furniture, or electrical appliances, for sale.

words.tr: phrase. 报名参加；注册（某项活动、课程或服务）
words.ex: He wants to sign up for the English class.
words.ex_cn: 他想报名参加英语课。
words.en: To agree to become involved in an organized activity.

words.ex: He is a sophomore at Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的二年级学生。
words.en: A sophomore is a student in the second year of college or high school.

words.ex: He is a specialist in heart surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他是心脏手术方面的专家。
words.en: A specialist is a person who is highly skilled or knowledgeable in a particular field.

words.ex: The spokesman spoke clearly at the press conference.
words.ex_cn: 发言人在新闻发布会上清晰地发言。
words.en: A spokesman is a man who speaks on behalf of a group or an organization.

words.tr: phrase. 教研室；员工休息室
words.ex: The teachers are having a meeting in the staff room.
words.ex_cn: 老师们正在教研室开会。
words.en: A room in a school or college where teachers can work and relax.

words.tr: phrase. 学生顾问；负责为学生提供学业或生活指导的教职人员
words.ex: The student advisor helped him choose his classes.
words.ex_cn: 学生顾问帮他选了课程。
words.en: A student advisor is a person who provides guidance and support to students, helping them with academic decisions, course selection, and other educational matters.

words.ex: He shows his student card to get a discount.
words.ex_cn: 他出示学生证来获得折扣。
words.en: A card issued by an educational institution to a student, which is used to identify the student and may provide access to certain facilities or services.

words.tr: phrase. 学生套装（通常指为学生设计的包含学习用品或优惠服务的组合包）
words.ex: The university offers a student pack that includes discounts on textbooks and software.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学提供了一个学生套餐，包含教科书和软件的折扣。
words.en: A set of materials or resources provided to a student for a particular course or program.

words.ex: The student representative spoke at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 学生代表在会议上发言了。
words.en: A student representative is a student who is chosen or elected to represent the views of all the students in a school, college, or university.

words.ex: The student union organized a free concert on campus.
words.ex_cn: 学生会在学校组织了一场免费音乐会。
words.en: The student union is an organization found in many colleges, universities, and high schools. In higher education, the student union is often accorded its own building on the campus, dedicated to social, organizational activities, representation, and academic support of the membership.

words.tr: phrase. 学生签证；允许外国学生在特定国家学习的官方许可文件
words.ex: She applied for a student visa to study abroad.
words.ex_cn: 她申请了留学签证去国外学习。
words.en: A student visa is a type of visa that allows a foreign national to enter a country for the purpose of studying at an accredited educational institution.

words.ex: The students sit quietly in the study hall.
words.ex_cn: 学生们安静地坐在自习室里。
words.en: A room in a school where students are sent to study quietly, usually under supervision.

words.tr: phrase. 主观题考试；需要考生自行组织答案、体现个人观点或分析能力的考试形式
words.ex: He took a subjective exam last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周参加了一次主观性考试。
words.en: An examination that is graded based on the examiner's personal judgment and interpretation of answers, rather than solely on objective, factual correctness.

words.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
words.ex_cn: 主管检查了工人们的进展。
words.en: A supervisor is a person who oversees and directs the work of others.

words.tr: phrase. 辅助人员，支持人员
words.ex: The supporting staff helped the teacher with the books.
words.ex_cn: 后勤人员帮老师整理了书籍。
words.en: Staff who assist in the functioning of an organization but are not engaged in its primary activities.

words.ex: He is a teaching assistant for math class.
words.ex_cn: 他是数学课的助教。
words.en: A teaching assistant is a person who helps a teacher in a classroom, often by providing support to students or helping with the preparation of lessons.

words.tr: phrase. 教师；教学人员；师资队伍
words.ex: The teaching staff helped the students with their homework.
words.ex_cn: 教师们帮助学生完成作业。
words.en: The group of people who teach in a school, college, or university.

words.ex: The camp had a test of leadership for the older kids.
words.ex_cn: 夏令营为大孩子们进行了一次领导力测试。
words.en: A situation or challenge that evaluates the effectiveness of a leader's abilities.

words.tr: phrase. 三年级学生；大学或学院的第三学年在读生
words.ex: He is a third-year student at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的三年级学生。
words.en: A third-year student is someone who is in their third year of study at a college or university.

words.tr: phrase. 转学生；从一所学校转到另一所学校就读的学生
words.ex: The transfer student quickly adapted to the new school environment.
words.ex_cn: 转学生迅速适应了新学校的环境。
words.en: A student who moves from one educational institution to another.

words.ex: I asked the school for a transcript of my grades.
words.ex_cn: 我向学校要了一份成绩单的副本。
words.en: A transcript is a written or printed version of something that has been recorded or spoken, especially in the context of academic records.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.ex: He earned an undergraduate diploma in business.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了工商专业的本科文凭。
words.en: An undergraduate diploma is a certificate awarded to students upon successful completion of a bachelor's degree program.

words.ex: He goes to university to study engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他上大学学习工程。
words.en: A university is an institution where students study for degrees and where academic research is done.

words.tr: n. 举办地点；（比赛）地点；会场；
words.ex: The concert will be held at a new venue.
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会将在一个新的举办地点举行。
words.en: A place where an event or meeting is held, such as a concert hall or conference center.

words.tr: n. 副总裁；副董事长；副总统；副校长
words.ex: He is the vice-president of the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是这家公司的副总裁。
words.en: A vice-president is an officer in government or business who is next in rank below a president and who takes the president's place when necessary.

words.tr: phrase. 职业文凭；职业教育所颁发的资格证书
words.ex: He earned a vocational diploma in car repair.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了汽车维修的职业文凭。
words.en: A vocational diploma is a certificate awarded to students who have completed a course of study in a specific trade or occupation, focusing on practical skills and knowledge required for the job.

words.tr: phrase. 职业学校；技术学校
words.ex: He went to a vocational school to learn car repair.
words.ex_cn: 他去了一所职业学校学习修车。
words.en: A vocational school is an educational institution designed to provide vocational education or technical skills required to perform the tasks of a particular and specific job.

words.tr: phrase. 福利主管；福利部门负责人
words.ex: The welfare director helps poor families.
words.ex_cn: 福利主任帮助贫困家庭。
words.en: A welfare director is an official responsible for the administration of welfare services in an organization or community.

words.tr: phrase. 入学或旅游时收到的欢迎辞
words.ex: When we arrived at the hotel, we got a welcome package with a map and a note.
words.ex_cn: 当我们到达酒店时，收到了一份包含地图和便条的欢迎礼包。
words.en: A welcome package is a collection of items or information given to someone new to a place or organization, intended to make them feel welcome and to provide them with useful information or items.

words.ex: The bird spread its wing to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞翔。
words.en: One of the two flat parts that stick out from the side of a bird's body and are used for flying.

words.ex: He passed the written test with high marks.
words.ex_cn: 他以高分通过了笔试。
words.en: A written test is an examination where the answers must be written, typically to assess knowledge or proficiency in a particular subject.

words.tr:
adj. 学术的；
n. 大学教师；学者；
words.ex: He published an academic paper on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于气候变化的学术论文。
words.en: relating to education, especially at college or university level

words.ex: He is popular in the academic circle.
words.ex_cn: 他在学术圈里很受欢迎。
words.en: The academic circle refers to the community of scholars and researchers engaged in higher education and scholarly research.

words.ex: He submitted his academic record to the university.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的学业成绩提交给了大学。
words.en: A document that provides a detailed account of a student's academic performance, including grades, courses taken, and degrees awarded.

words.tr: phrase. 学术研究；学业学习
words.ex: He does academic study every day after school.
words.ex_cn: 他每天放学后都进行学术学习。
words.en: Academic study refers to the process of learning and researching in a scholarly manner, often within an educational institution.

words.tr: phrase. 学术写作；指在学术环境中用于表达研究、论证和分析的正式写作风格
words.ex: He practices academic writing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习学术写作。
words.en: Academic writing is a style of expression that researchers use to define the intellectual boundaries of their disciplines and specific areas of expertise.

words.tr: n. 会计工作；会计职业；
words.ex: He works in accountancy for a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家大公司从事会计工作。
words.en: Accountancy is the theory or practice of keeping and inspecting financial accounts.

words.ex: He works as an accountant in a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司当会计师。

words.en: Advanced English studies refer to higher-level courses or programs focused on the in-depth learning and understanding of the English language, its literature, and its use in various contexts.

words.en: The science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals to provide food, wool, and other products.

words.ex: He loves watching stars and learning astronomy.

words.en: Banking refers to the business activity of accepting and safeguarding money owned by other individuals and entities, and then lending out this money in order to earn a profit.

words.ex: He is taking a basic course in math.
words.ex_cn: 他正在上一门基础数学课程。
words.en: A basic course is an introductory course that covers the fundamental aspects of a subject.

words.ex: He is a beginner in piano lessons.
words.ex_cn: 他是钢琴课的初学者。
words.en: A beginner is someone who has just started learning to do something and has not yet mastered it.

words.tr: phrase. 初级课程；入门课程

words.ex_cn: 他报名参加了一个西班牙语入门课程。
words.en: An introductory or initial level of study or instruction in a particular subject or field.

words.tr: adj. 两种语言的；用两种语言的；

words.ex_cn: 他是一个会说英语和西班牙语的双语学生。
words.en: A bilingual person is someone who can speak two languages equally well.

words.ex: This is a biological experiment.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个生物学实验。
words.en: Relating to biology or living organisms.

words.ex: The biologist studies animals in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位生物学家在森林里研究动物。
words.en: A biologist is a scientist who studies living organisms and their relationship to their environment.

words.en: Biology is the science which is concerned with the study of living things.

words.ex: The garden has a botanical section for native plants.

words.en: Relating to plants or the scientific study of plants.

words.ex: The botanist studies plants in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位植物学家在森林里研究植物。
words.en: A botanist is a scientist who studies plants.

words.ex: He loves studying botany in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在花园里学习植物学。
words.en: Botany is the scientific study of plants.

words.ex: He runs a small business selling bread.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家卖面包的小生意。
words.en: Business refers to the activity of buying and selling goods and services, or a particular company that does this.

words.ex: He is taking business studies at high school.
words.ex_cn: 他在高中学习商业研究。
words.en: Business studies is an academic subject that teaches the principles of business, management, and economics.

words.tr: phrase. 个案研究；案例分析；调查研究

words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于小企业的案例研究。
words.en: A case study is a detailed examination of a particular case or situation, especially in order to understand its complexities or to test a theory.

words.tr:

words.en: A chemical is a substance that is used in or produced by a process involving chemistry.

words.en: A chemist is a scientist who specializes in chemistry, or in some contexts, a person who is qualified to prepare and dispense drugs and medicines.

words.ex: He likes chemistry because it is fun.

words.en: Chemistry is the scientific study of the structure of substances and how they react with each other.

words.ex: Good communication helps people understand each other.
words.ex_cn: 良好的交流有助于人们相互理解。
words.en: The imparting or exchanging of information by speaking, writing, or using some other medium.

words.ex: Math is a compulsory course for all students.
words.ex_cn: 数学是所有学生的必修课。
words.en: A compulsory course is a subject that students are required to take as part of their curriculum.

words.tr: n. 计算机操作；计算； v. “compute”的现在分词；

words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.ex: The school changed its curriculum last year.
